summary: Positive scaling preserves answer-bank shortcuts across all 11 profiles, including every surviving batch record. The generator also omits complete easy source q-20450. Mathematics, native grading, representative rendering and packaging checks passed; package files are unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Solve a three-variable upper-triangular system using back substitution and select its ordered solution vector.
reasoning_steps: Read the third variable from the last equation.
Substitute into the second equation and isolate the second variable.
Substitute both known values into the first equation and isolate the first variable.
Match the ordered triple to one of five radio choices, in angle-vector or column-vector notation.
invariants: Three equations with unit leading coefficients and a unique solution; supplied as equations rather than an augmented matrix.
Easy signed integer and small rational arithmetic; two substitution stages.
One correct vector in five distinct choices; coordinate order follows variable order.
permitted_variations: Vary signed coefficients and small rational right-hand sides within the observed workload.
Vary signs, zero/nonzero values, and rational/integer status of solution coordinates; no source coordinate is intrinsically fixed.
Vary xyz versus indexed variable names, angle versus column vectors, correct-choice position and plausible wrong coordinate roles.
Cancellation allowing x to be found directly is legitimate algebra when it occurs, not a requirement to enforce in every instance.

source_replay.details: All 11 supported profiles replay their source equations and complete banks. Complete easy q-20450 is rejected. Incomplete q-20451 is documented separately, without inventing missing source fields.

math.details: Independent exact solutions, unique correct choices and displayed substitution equalities passed for 33 samples, five batch records and three controlled records.

variety.details: Only positive homothetic scaling is supported. Signs, zero coordinates, equalities and ordering remain fixed within each source bank. Conditional bank-only strategies succeed on 33/33 samples and 5/5 batch records, including 28/28 and 4/4 respective delivery survivors.

scope.details: Tested outputs retain three unit-pivot triangular equations, two substitution stages, small rational arithmetic and one five-choice vector response.

grading.details: Native application grader correctly handled 275 responses: 111 accepted and 164 rejected. All fields are radio; free-entry equivalence is inapplicable. This includes actual submissions produced by shortcut strategies.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered six representative records and seven delivered/control records. Inspected screenshots confirm mathematical notation, radio controls and worked solutions. UI shuffling does not remove demonstrated order-independent shortcuts. Reviewer-created indexed counterfactual has a long horizontally overflowing equality, documented separately.

packaging.details: Exact Python 3.13.5 and SymPy 1.14.0 match manifest. Deterministic replay, relocation and invalid scale/count/difficulty rejection passed. Package hashes are unchanged; no assets were published or database content written.

decision_variation.details: Controlled scaling and variable-renaming dependencies passed, but eligible answer roles cannot change within a profile. Template-conditioned sign/equality/order shortcuts survive normalization, deduplication, UI shuffle and any nonempty eligible subset of the four surviving batch records. Captured inventory basis 5578 contains only original sources, no historical generated records to repair.

findings.description: The family-wide rule scales every RHS and every source-bank coordinate by the same positive k. It therefore freezes incidental answer-bearing signs, equalities and order relations. For q-129453, selecting the sole vector with positive middle coordinate succeeds without using any RHS. Other simple conditional rules cover all 11 profiles, including all four surviving runner-batch records.
